 PlayStation Game is Permanently Shutting Down on November 25 
 From GameRant (Written by Dalton Cooper) on November 7, 2026 | OpenCritic 
 A PlayStation game is going to shut down forever come Wednesday, November 25. In the age of live-service games and titles that otherwise have extensive online multiplayer features, it's a sad reality that various games shutter large portions of their content, or, in the worst scenarios, completely cease to exist. These shutdowns impact nearly all companies with online games, PlayStation included.
 Many times it's third-party publishers that are shutting down games. EA shuts down games on a near-monthly basis , and 2K has its fair share of game shutdowns as well. However, there are times when the console-makers shut down their games, too. Nintendo has shut down various mobile games and even titles like Super Mario Maker , and soon PlayStation will be shutting down one of its PS5 exclusive games.
 Sony officially adds a warning to boxes of new PlayStation 5 consoles that could be raising some eyebrows.
 Come November 25, Destruction AllStars will effectively cease to exist. Destruction AllStars is a PlayStation-published vehicular combat game that originally had a big focus on its online multiplayer component, with live-service elements to boot.
